paragraphs: I am a second-year undergraduate studying Computer Science and Technology at Shanghai Jiao Tong University, which I joined in 2025. My interests include artificial intelligence, large language models, and the development of algorithms and software systems.

My research training includes data collection, quality control and experimental framework design for AmbiHTMLBench, as well as work on an autonomous-driving and automation project. I also served as a teaching assistant for a Python fundamentals course.

news.text: AmbiHTMLBench is being prepared for submission to ICLR 2027, with submission planned for September 25, 2026.
Served as a teaching assistant for Python Fundamentals at the 2026 Zhuli Camp.
Served as a student assistant in the Operations Management Office of Academic Affairs.

researchInterests.title: Large Language Models and Machine Learning
researchInterests.description: I am interested in how data quality and experimental design influence the evaluation of large language models. My work on AmbiHTMLBench involves collecting and organizing data, checking its quality, and contributing to experimental code.

researchInterests.title: Algorithms and Autonomous Systems
researchInterests.description: I am interested in connecting algorithm development with working software systems. My summer research training involved algorithm design, deployment, simulation testing and technical reporting in autonomous driving and automation.

projects.title: AmbiHTMLBench
projects.description: Collect, quality-check and organize data, and contribute to the design of parts of the experimental code framework. The project concerns large language models and machine learning. A submission to ICLR 2027 is planned for September 25, 2026.
